_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Agorɔfoɔ Surround a ɛwɔ {width}x{height} grid so.
Wo ne agorɔfoɔ {player_id}. Nkrabea a ɛfata: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' anaa w/s/a/d.
Botaeɛ: di agorɔfoɔ afoforɔ nkɔ. Trails yɛ owuo; wall hits kum; head-on crashes kum agorɔfoɔ baako.

board.after_moves: Board a wɔayi no bere koro mu: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Ɔbɔfo {player_id} wui esiane sɛ na ne si yɛ nea ɛmfata nti.

outcome.survived_win: Ɔbɔadeɛ {player_id} nyaa nkwa; wɔn a aka no nyinaa tɔe.
outcome.all_crashed: Asisifo no nyinaa bɔɔ wɔn ho akuturuku bere koro mu.
outcome.outlived: Ɔbɔfo no traa ase sen afoforo nyinaa.
outcome.turn_limit: Sɛ wadu wo dan no so a, nea ne ho ntwaa pii sen obiara di nkonim.
